title: 1930s Ice rink at the bottom of Carr's hill
description: The Hartland outdoor ice rink was located at the bottom of Carr’s Hill, behind a warehouse once owned by C. Rideout and later by William MacLeod. Pictured on the left is Ethel Christian Bailey, and third from the left is Dorothy Keith MacLeod. The identities of the other individuals are unknown.
